STS2ARIS-ARIS_PRAISE_STICKER.title: Aris' Praise Sticker
STS2ARIS-ARIS_PRAISE_STICKER.description: Whenever you complete a [gold]Quest[/gold], heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
STS2ARIS-ARIS_PRAISE_STICKER.flavor: It won't make everything go smoothly or boost your Luck stat...but it is filled with Aris' heartfelt support.
STS2ARIS-MASKED_COMMANDER.title: Maestra of the Masquerade
STS2ARIS-MASKED_COMMANDER.description: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Equipment[/gold] card with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It is free to play this turn.
STS2ARIS-MASKED_COMMANDER.flavor: Until you play a Rogue card... Wait, Aris, you brought the wrong game!
STS2ARIS-JOYSTICK.title: Joystick
STS2ARIS-JOYSTICK.description: Once each turn, ignore [gold]Output[/gold]. Cannot ignore [gold]Output[/gold] on X-cost cards.
STS2ARIS-JOYSTICK.flavor: "Sensei! If you enter that command with frame-perfect timing, you can cancel the recovery of your special move!"
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC.title: Enhancement Magic!
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC.description: The first time [gold]Class Change[/gold] triggers each combat, gain {ChargePower:chargeIcon(0)}.
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC.flavor: "Aris does not believe that magic is absent from Kivotos."
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC_PLUS.title: Enhancement Magic!+
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC_PLUS.descriptio: Replaces [red]Enhancement[/red] [red]Magic![/red] The first time [gold]Class Change[/gold] triggers each turn, gain {ChargePower:chargeIcon()}.
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC_PLUS.flavor: "Magic exists. After all, Sensei has made Aris happy."
STS2ARIS-H_P_POTION.title: Enhancement Potion
STS2ARIS-H_P_POTION.description: The first time you take damage during your turn each combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
STS2ARIS-BATTERY.title: Battery
STS2ARIS-BATTERY.description: The first time [gold]Shock[/gold] is applied to an enemy without [gold]Shock[/gold], apply [blue]{ShockAmount}[/blue] additional [gold]Shock[/gold].
STS2ARIS-GAME_MANUAL.title: Returning Player Guide
STS2ARIS-GAME_MANUAL.description: Upon pickup, receive [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Card Rewards containing only [gold]Quest[/gold] cards.
STS2ARIS-GAME_MANUAL.flavor: A collection of quests provided to returning players.
STS2ARIS-STARTING_EQUIPMENT.title: Starter Equipment
STS2ARIS-STARTING_EQUIPMENT.description: The first time you play an [gold]Equipment[/gold] card each combat, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
STS2ARIS-STARTING_EQUIPMENT.flavor: Equipment given out for free in the starting village.
STS2ARIS-IRONCLAD_CLASS_RELIC.title: Warrior's Token
STS2ARIS-IRONCLAD_CLASS_RELIC.descriptio: Transform [gold]Super Nova[/gold] into [gold]Warrior's Mask[/gold] and receive 2 [gold]Ironclad[/gold] Card Rewards. [gold]Ironclad[/gold] cards can now appear in Card Rewards.
STS2ARIS-IRONCLAD_CLASS_RELIC.flavor: Aris is tough enough to be called a true warrior.
STS2ARIS-SILENT_CLASS_RELIC.title: Rogue's Token
STS2ARIS-SILENT_CLASS_RELIC.description: Upon pickup, transform [gold]Super Nova[/gold] into [gold]Rogue's Dagger[/gold] and receive 2 [gold]Silent[/gold] Card Rewards. [gold]Silent[/gold] cards can now appear in Card Rewards.
STS2ARIS-SILENT_CLASS_RELIC.flavor: Aris has always enjoyed Shiv decks.
STS2ARIS-DEFECT_CLASS_RELIC.title: Defect's Token
STS2ARIS-DEFECT_CLASS_RELIC.description: Upon pickup, transform [gold]Super Nova[/gold] into [gold]Machine Mask[/gold] and receive 2 [gold]Defect[/gold] Card Rewards. [gold]Defect[/gold] cards can now appear in Card Rewards.
STS2ARIS-DEFECT_CLASS_RELIC.flavor: "Sensei, please check this 'I'm not a robot' box for Aris!"
STS2ARIS-NECROBINDER_CLASS_RELIC.title: Dark Mage's Token
STS2ARIS-NECROBINDER_CLASS_RELIC.descrip: Upon pickup, transform [gold]Super Nova[/gold] into [gold]Reaper's Scythe[/gold] and receive 2 [gold]Necrobinder[/gold] Card Rewards. [gold]Necrobinder[/gold] cards can now appear in Card Rewards.
STS2ARIS-NECROBINDER_CLASS_RELIC.flavor: Aris has always admired magic, even dark magic.
STS2ARIS-REGENT_CLASS_RELIC.title: Princess's Token
STS2ARIS-REGENT_CLASS_RELIC.description: Upon pickup, transform [gold]Super Nova[/gold] into the [gold]Throne of Stars[/gold] and receive 2 [gold]Regent[/gold] Card Rewards. [gold]Regent[/gold] cards can now appear in Card Rewards.
STS2ARIS-REGENT_CLASS_RELIC.flavor: Probably not the princess you were thinking of.
STS2ARIS-HOSHINO_CLASS_RELIC.title: Tank's Token
STS2ARIS-HOSHINO_CLASS_RELIC.description: Upon pickup, transform [gold]Super Nova[/gold] into [gold]Tank Equipment[/gold] and receive 2 [gold]Hoshino[/gold] Card Rewards. [gold]Hoshino[/gold] cards can now appear in Card Rewards.
STS2ARIS-HOSHINO_CLASS_RELIC.flavor: This weapon may be too light for Aris.
STS2ARIS-KEI_CLASS_RELIC.title: Key's Token
STS2ARIS-KEI_CLASS_RELIC.description: Upon pickup, transform [gold]Super Nova[/gold] into [gold]Luminous Nova[/gold].
STS2ARIS-KEI_CLASS_RELIC.flavor: "I'll kill Sensei, then myself!" - Aris impersonating Kei
